data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'anajaha', which means 'to aid' or 'to support'. In Islamic history, Naajih refers to a righteous and helpful person. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
